source.original_title: 05/28/2026 - Sharmeena Syed x Harry Edmonds KFS
source.display_title: 05/28/2026 - Sharmeena Syed x Harry Edmonds KFS — Follow Up

call.sequence_note: Two prior setter conversations with Kim — one with the husband alone at the outset, then a joint call with both of them the previous week. Sharmeena references questions already answered: 'last time, I did ask a few questions and I had them answered already'. This is the first closer call.

setter.name: Kim Forbes-Sobers
setter.evidence: 'I know you, did you speak with Kim?' and 'I do have notes from Kim, but I just wanna get a good understanding from my perspective'. A team member named Sophia is also referenced: 'I think Sophia and Kim had my number the whole time.'

prospect.name: Sharmeena Syed
prospect.aka: Sharmeena Lalloo — the name on the Zoom account and the only speaker label in the transcript
prospect.location: Canada (pricing converted to Canadian dollars); grew up in Saudi Arabia, British-school educated, lived in England for about a year from age eight
prospect.family_status: Married to Hanan, who was present for the whole call, follows Trevor and initiated the enquiry. The coaching is for Sharmeena.
prospect.training_background: Describes herself as not super athletic; started training about two years ago with a personal trainer for roughly a year doing machines and weights, which improved her strength materially before she stopped because she disliked the gym and the fixed, linear movements. Eight-plus months of Pilates. Self-taught kettlebells through the SIS app by UK influencer Dina Tokio, knowing basic movements including the clean. Uses a 6.5 kg bell for anything overhead and a 14 kg for squats and swings. Cannot do a full push-up but found she could do knee push-ups after kettlebell work. Has not trained for about a month due to travel.
prospect.medical: Nothing disclosed. No conditions, injuries or medications mentioned by either participant, and none were asked about.

signals: Proposed label: spouse_introduced_novice. She is a relatively new trainee (two years, cannot do a full push-up) brought to the offer by an enthusiastic partner who has followed Trevor for eighteen months to two years and who ran the enquiry, asked the setter whether Trevor even trains women, and led the money conversation on this call. None of the listed avatars fit: she is not an optimizer, not rebuilding lost ground, not medically constrained, not a preserver, and not pre-sold enough to be a warm referral — she asked for a discount and left to think.
The closest listed label is the_warm_referral, but the partner is a follower of the content rather than an existing client, so the price was not pre-framed and resistance was present
Her buying motivation is knowledge and progression rather than outcome: 'I want to be able to understand how to adjust my own movements'

goals.text: Understand how to progress — how to know when and how to increase weight
Get genuinely stronger, especially in the lower body, which has not improved since she left the gym
Learn the foundations and correct form of the basic kettlebell movements
Own the knowledge so she can programme for herself for the rest of her life — 'I kind of want a long-term understanding'
Find one thing she can commit to long term after trying several
Combine mobility and strength in one practice — Pilates gives her mobility but no strength
See some tangible change and feel fitter, though explicitly not focused on looks or weight loss

pains.text: No idea how to progress — has used the same weights for months without a route upward
The app she follows recycles the same programmes and mixes too many movements to learn from
Lower body strength has regressed since leaving the gym and she does not know how to load it with kettlebells
Strength mismatch between movements — 6.5 kg is right overhead but far too light for a clean, and she cannot resolve it
Disliked the gym — travel time and fixed, isolated machine movements
Has tried several modalities without finding one that lasts
Under-eats and dislikes protein — 'I do lack on protein a little bit, mostly because I don't like protein'
A month with no training after travel

objections.raw_quote: Is there any, like, negotiation at all? Or is it like a set-fix thing
objections.rep_response: Held the price completely — 'Can't even take a cent off' — then volunteered payment structures unprompted: full up front, or half down with the balance inside 90 days, or monthly at a higher total

objections.raw_quote: definitely We will think about it
objections.rep_response: Time-boxed it — 'How long do you guys feel like you need?' — agreed a day or two, swapped the contact number to Sharmeena's and asked only that they not leave him hanging

tiers.price_stated: 8,200 CAD, explicitly derived as 'it's 6k US which is 8200 canadian'

offer.payment_plan_terms: 'Most people just take care of it up front, put it on a credit card... The other option I recommend people is you can do half down, and then half... As long as the other half is done within 90 days, you're fine. You can do it monthly, but it works out to be more, so I wouldn't recommend doing it monthly.' The monthly total was never stated.
offer.guarantee_mentioned: 'From the start in weight... I think you said you started like six and a half, in the main basic movements by the end of the six months, you'll be using an eight kilo heavier kettlebell than what you use now... we kind of put our money where our mouth is with that one, so we work with you for free until you get that.'

evidence: No decision and no payment: 'We will think about it' and 'we'll just discuss that and figure it out and then get back to you'
Timeline agreed at a day or two, and the contact number was switched from the husband's to Sharmeena's so the rep could text her directly
Engagement was high — she asked questions about check-ins, oversight, extension, accountability and coaching style right to the end
Counter-evidence: the discount request ('Is there any, like, negotiation at all?') was refused outright and the price stands at CAD 8,200
Counter-evidence: no follow-up call was booked and no commitment of any kind was obtained before or after the price
outcome.next_step: Couple to discuss the cost and come back within a day or two; rep to text Sharmeena directly as 'Harry from Trevor's team'

notable.note: Payment policy stated here — full up front, or half down with the balance within 90 days, or monthly at an unstated higher total — flatly contradicts the 'six months, one shot' and 'it's a one-time payment' given to two prospects the day before, and the third-party finance route described to another. The price was also held absolutely ('Can't even take a cent off') one day after the same rep walked a different prospect down to a EUR 1,030 trial. Separately, the husband had to ask the setter whether Trevor trains women at all and got 'kinda, yeah, sure', and Sharmeena raised that she may not be able to send the standard progress photos, which the rep waived without difficulty.

quality.notes: Three people are on this call and only two labels exist — both Sharmeena and her husband Hanan appear under 'Sharmeena Lalloo', so prospect-side turns cannot be reliably separated; several rep lines also sit under her label, including large parts of the pitch from 00:21:00 and the whole pricing passage around 00:28:00. The title also names Sharmeena Syed while every label reads Sharmeena Lalloo. Roles were resolved from content, and where it matters the record notes which of the two spoke.
